📚 NOTESHARE

{/* Hero Section */}

Welcome to NOTESHARE

A UL Students File Sharing Project. Share, search, and access study materials securely — powered by verified school email access and a reliable file-sharing system.

Get Started
{/* Features Section */}

Core Features

✅ Verified Accounts

Register with your official school email to ensure a secure and trusted community of students.

✅ Upload & Download Notes

Share study notes, guides, and resources, and download files from your classmates.

✅ Search by Course

Quickly find materials by entering a course code or class name.

✅ Ratings & Feedback

Rate and review uploaded files to highlight the most useful content for everyone.

✅ Groups

Create and join class-based groups and get recommendations for group-shared materials.

{/* Call to Action */}

Ready to share and access notes?

Join NOTESHARE today and collaborate with fellow students.

Sign Up Now
